crossRefs.note: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place…
For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light…
You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of…
For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,
He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’
Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for…
For Sheol can’t praise you. Death can’t celebrate you. Those who go down into the pit can’t hope for your truth.
I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’
To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go…

parallels.note: “Yahweh kills and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol and brings up.

translations.web: Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
translations.bsb: O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.
translations.kjv: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
translations.asv: O Jehovah, thou hast brought up my soul from Sheol; Thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
